# The Gutter Team

> Gutter cleaning, downpipe unblocking and gutter repairs across Farnborough, Fleet, Camberley, Farnham and the surrounding towns. Enquiries by email go to one vetted local gutter specialist per area. Typical prices are published and confirmed before booking.

## Prices
- [Gutter cleaning cost and estimator](https://www.gutterteam.co.uk/advice/gutter-cleaning-cost/): Terraced house (2 storey) £65-£100; Semi-detached house (2 storey) £80-£125; Detached house (2 storey) £110-£190; Bungalow or chalet bungalow £60-£105; Three-storey house or town house £140-£250; Low-rise flats or maisonette block £150-£400

## Services
- [Gutter Cleaning](https://www.gutterteam.co.uk/services/gutter-cleaning/): Full clearance of every gutter run, outlets checked, and photos before and after.
- [Downpipe Unblocking](https://www.gutterteam.co.uk/services/downpipe-unblocking/): Blocked downpipes cleared from the top or the shoe, then flow-tested.
- [Gutter Repairs](https://www.gutterteam.co.uk/services/gutter-repairs/): Leaking joints resealed, brackets replaced, sagging runs realigned.
- [Gutter Guards](https://www.gutterteam.co.uk/services/gutter-guards/): Brush, mesh or foam guards fitted where they genuinely reduce clearing.
- [Fascia and Soffit Cleaning](https://www.gutterteam.co.uk/services/fascia-soffit-cleaning/): uPVC fascias, soffits and gutter faces washed back to clean white.
- [Annual Maintenance Plans](https://www.gutterteam.co.uk/services/annual-maintenance/): Scheduled cleans each year, with a dated photo record.
